They sigh and sit criss cross on the ground near Bo's chair. "It's good to hear all of this. I.... I appreciate it." They pause for a long time. "I've heard you sing in goblin, so you must know a bit about how our tribes usually work. Believe it or not, they have an organized power structure. A clear leader. Roles and tasks for everyone. Our tribe was... Different. It was run by whoever could cause the most chaos, which we were especially well known for." They pause, "I was able to thrive in this environment... Where I could do what I wanted and be rewarded for causing destruction. But it was at a cost. Everyone was always looking to out smart the person ahead of them. There was always some trick or strings attached. It grew tiring. So I left for the city... Only to find the same was true here." They rub their hand across their eyes, "point is, trust doesn't come easy to me. And old habits die hard. I keep myself to simple goals like building my armor and fighting coats because if I don't, I feel like the whole word is out to get me."
